author: GamingBolt
description:
Fresh off the back of its Steam Next Fest success, where it ended up as one of the most-downloaded and wishlisted titles, Mistfall Hunter developer Bellring Games is gearing up for its full release. Largely unrecognisable from early builds, the PvPvE extraction ARPG has grown in complexity, with deeply customisable character classes, specific archetype paths to follow, and numerous weapon skills to master raising the barriers to entry. 

Crucially, however, to counteract this the studio has implemented numerous systems to ease the friction of long-term progression. We’ll get into these, and more, as part of the fifteen things you need to know before you buy Mistfall Hunter.
title: Mistfall Hunter - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
It'd be hard to pinpoint what makes Black Flag or its remake Resynced so irresistibly fun to play. Or so we thought, until we sat down and had a talk about how the new game immediately exposes ways in which the developer could do better when it comes to new ideas. 

Of course, the franchise’s RPG-based games immediately come to mind as examples of how ambition turned to apathy in making a bold new direction for the franchise fall flat. Join us as we take a look at what is and what’s been happening in the Animus, and how future forays into its depths could be better if the developer pulls up its socks far enough to get the franchise back to its former glory.
title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resycned Accidentally Exposed Assassin's Creed's BIGGEST Problem

author: GamingBolt
description:
As a whole, however, I'm entranced by the Beast of Reincarnation's ambience – this quest at the end of the world, where even success won't necessarily mean everything goes back to normal. The mystery surrounding the titular Beast and Koo (and no, I won't accept that there's no connection between them). The combat bristling with all its tactical options, bridging the gap between skill-based action and smart ability usage. Above all else, the presentation blows everything that Game Freak has done before out of the water in terms of art direction and fidelity.

Beast of Reincarnation launches on August 3rd for Xbox Series X/S, PS5, and PC. Maybe it'll get lost in the shuffle of major releases; maybe it'll find an audience beyond action RPG fans. But there's something about it that warrants a deeper dive into its world and what it really means to survive.
title: You Are ABSOLUTELY Not Ready For Beast of Reincarnation
